description: Build the 5-tx Withdraw saga. Agent supplies equality (320 B) + range U64 (936 B) proofs + new AES decryptable (36 B), plus the two ephemeral ctx-state pubkeys.

amount.description: Amount in base units as a decimal string (not a float). For a 6-decimal mint, "1000000" is 1 token.

decimals.description: The mint's decimals. Must match the mint exactly.

equalityContextAccount.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

equalityProof.description: Base64 of the ciphertext-commitment equality proof from your ZK worker.

mint.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

newDecryptableAvailable.description: Base64 of the 36-byte AES-encrypted new available balance your worker computed.

owner.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

rangeContextAccount.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

rangeProof.description: Base64 of the range proof from your ZK worker.

name: solknife_ct_withdraw_build
